description: This source file implements the 'hash-object' command in Git, providing functionality to hash files, standard input, and paths, then output their object IDs. It includes functions for hashing files via file descriptors, handling command-line options, and integrating with Git's object database.

methods.name: void hash_fd(int fd,const char * type,const char * path,unsigned flags)
methods.description: Hashes a file descriptor for a given object type, updating the repository index if required, and outputs the resulting object ID.

methods.name: void hash_object(const char * path,const char * type,const char * vpath,unsigned flags)
methods.description: Opens a file by path and hashes it using hash_fd.

methods.name: void hash_stdin_paths(const char * type,int no_filters,unsigned flags)
methods.description: Reads file paths from stdin and hashes each as an object of specified type.

methods.name: int cmd_hash_object(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Main command function parsing options, handling different input sources, and invoking hashing routines accordingly.
